evidence.reason: Line 695 extracts dependency names with `CRQ_NAME_RE.findall(value)`, so a non-CRQ unit argument such as `backup-crq-tick.service` yields the substring `crq-tick.service`. For an undeclared source that substring is in `expected`, so the scanner incorrectly records a foreign dependency and rejects a valid topology; for a declared source it can also fail to flag the actual outside unit. The directive value should be split into complete unit-name arguments and compared by full name, while preserving rejection of an exact `crq-tick.service`. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the existing discovery behavior, not a new requirement.
